title: Workflows
description: Orchestrate work across people and agents with visible activities and evidence.

create.title: Start a workflow
create.description: Creates a host issue and starts the selected published workflow in one action.
create.issue_description_placeholder: Describe the goal, scope, and acceptance criteria...
create.no_templates: Publish a template before starting a workflow.

run.title: Run workflow
run.description: Start a run directly from this template. An issue is only created by activities that need one.
run.name: Run name
run.instructions_placeholder: Describe the goal, context, and expected outcome...

start.title: Start workflow from this issue
start.description: Choose a published workflow version, assign its roles, and turn this issue into the workflow's host.
start.existing_description: Choose the host issue, a published workflow version, and the required role assignments.
start.no_host_issues: No eligible open top-level issues are available.
start.no_templates: No published templates are available. Ask a workspace admin to publish one first.
start.template_load_failed: The selected template could not be loaded. Choose another template or try again.
start.no_eligible_actor: No eligible actor is available for this required role.
start.independent_help: Recommended for an existing issue. Workflow progress will not change its status.
start.managed_help: Starting sets the issue to in_progress; workflow completion sets it to done.

runs.intervention_description: Runs waiting for setup, a decision, or repair are kept at the top.
runs.description: Every run of every workflow in this workspace.
runs.empty_description: Runs will appear here after a workflow starts.

templates.title: Workflows
templates.empty_description: Create one, or start from a template.
templates.admin_only: Only workspace owners and admins can manage templates.
templates.metadata_description: Update the template name, description, and the issue type it applies to.
templates.name: Template name
templates.archive_description: Archived templates remain visible in history and existing runs, but cannot start new workflows.
templates.archived_help: This template is archived and read-only. Existing runs and published versions remain available.
templates.builtin_description: Ready-to-use delivery flows shipped with Multica. Create one to start immediately, or edit it afterwards.
templates.delete_description: “{{name}}” and its saved versions are removed for good. This cannot be undone.
templates.delete_blocked: This workflow has runs, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead — the runs stay readable and it can no longer start new ones.

workbench.title: Workflow workbench
workbench.host_details_description: Description, comments, attachments, and activity history
workbench.adopt_as_artifact_help: Pick the deliverable this file fulfils. The file stays where it is — this records that it is what the activity owes.
workbench.role_setup_help: Assign every required role so the first activity can start.
workbench.role_setup_waiting: The workflow starter or a workspace admin must assign the missing roles.
workbench.completion_rule_done: All required issues must be done
workbench.completion_rule_terminal: All required issues must reach a terminal status
workbench.completion_rule_none: Issue status does not gate this activity
workbench.direct_execution_help: This activity is assigned directly to an agent or squad. It has its own task and run history without creating an issue.
workbench.review_decision_help: Passing moves the activity on. Sending it back returns the work to its executor for another attempt. Both are recorded as a verdict.
workbench.executor_required: Choose an executor before the workflow can continue
workbench.choose_executor: Choose a member, agent, or squad
workbench.manual_executor_reason: Configured manually in the workflow workbench
workbench.add_dynamic_issue_help: The new issue is scoped to this node and the host requirement.
workbench.admin_actions_help: Force complete, skip, and rollback record the operator and reason.
workbench.complete_activity_help: Complete the activity after its conditions are met.
workbench.complete_dialog_help: Review the completion form and finish this activity.
workbench.completion_note_placeholder: Add context for the next activity...
workbench.task_scoped_completion_form_help: Submit the completion form for every required issue in the Completion form tab before completing this activity.
workbench.choose_submission_source: Choose the task for this submission
workbench.detach_issue_description: {{identifier}} will not be deleted, but it will no longer belong to “{{activity}}” or affect this activity’s completion progress.
workbench.detach_issue_unavailable: This issue is no longer linked to an activity task. Refresh and try again.
workbench.detach_issue_audit_reason: Removed from the activity in the workflow workbench
workbench.cancel_workflow_help: Cancellation closes all open nodes and cannot be undone.
workbench.select_node: Select an activity to inspect its work and evidence.
workbench.role_reassign_help: Owners of nodes still in flight update with the change; assignees of issues already created stay as they are — reassign those separately if needed.
workbench.rework_criterion_placeholder: e.g. AC-004, or the failing test name
workbench.rework_gap_placeholder: What should have happened, and what happened instead
workbench.rework_hint_placeholder: A file, function, or the part of the approach to revisit
workbench.rework_reason_help: The executor redoing this work reads these verbatim. A one-line reason gives it nothing to act on.
workbench.rework_badge_title: This work was sent back — it is on attempt {{attempt}}.
workbench.routing_pending: This decision has not run yet.
workbench.routing_unknown: The routing record does not name a branch.
workbench.routing_not_evaluated: Not evaluated — an earlier branch had already matched
workbench.output_validation_failed: The delivery was refused — these fields need fixing:
workbench.output_problem_enum: not one of the allowed values

editor.title: Workflow template
editor.description: Each node is an activity container. Issues, executors, submissions, and checks live inside it.
editor.leave_description: Returning to the workflow list now will discard your unsaved changes.
editor.conflict: This workflow was saved elsewhere. Refresh before saving again.
editor.superseded_description: Your unsaved edits are still here. Saving them will be refused until you start from the current version.
editor.active_runs_unchanged: This will not modify workflow instances already running.
editor.mobile_read_only: Template editing is read-only on mobile. Use a larger screen to change the graph.
editor.graph_help: Nodes are activity containers or controls; edges define the actual execution path.
editor.roles_help: Roles are the slots a run fills at start; nodes address people through them rather than by name.
editor.select_node: Select a node on the graph to edit it.
editor.connections_help: Use + on an edge to insert in series, or the branch handle on a node to add a parallel path. Configure branch rules here.
editor.issue_policy_auto_hint: One issue per run, titled after the run and this activity. Its description carries the activity description and a link back to the requirement.
editor.issue_policy_deprecated_hint: Runtime decomposition is retired. Break the work down as sub-issues under this activity’s own issue instead — switch to fixed tasks and declare that issue.
editor.no_outgoing: This node has no outgoing edge
editor.default_branch_help: This path is used only when no conditional branch matches.
editor.fixed_tasks_disabled: Fixed templates are available only for fixed or fixed-and-dynamic policies.
editor.artifacts_hint: What this activity must deliver. Downstream activities read the index and fetch a body only when they need it.
editor.artifact_description_hint: e.g. implementation path, blast radius, how it was verified
editor.completion_mode_automatic_help: The workflow advances automatically when every completion condition is met.
editor.completion_mode_manual_help: After every completion condition is met, a person completes the activity.
editor.owner_confirmation_member_only: Owner confirmation is available only when the owner role resolves exclusively to members.
editor.timeout_minutes_hint: A timeout only raises a reminder and marker; the node is never failed, skipped, or rolled back automatically. 0 disables the timeout.
editor.node_events_hint: Automatically updates the host issue status when the node activates or completes; leave empty to skip. Applies regardless of the host status mode as an explicit template instruction.
editor.completion_authorized_roles_hint: Workspace admins can always operate; members resolved from the checked roles may also force-complete, skip, or roll back this node.
editor.runtime_button_review: Pass / Send back — the reviewer decides once the activity enters review.
editor.runtime_button_auto: No button — the activity moves on by itself once its conditions are met.
editor.runtime_button_rollback: Roll back — after the activity completes, admins and the authorized roles above can send it back.
editor.node_owner_hint: The owner decides who can confirm this node. With a role, whoever starts the workflow picks the actor for that role; a pinned member is the confirmer in every instance.
editor.executor_fallback_hint: Used when the executor above resolves to nobody.
editor.reviewer_hint: Automatic advances when delivery conditions pass. With an approver, approval completes the node and rejection sends it to rework.
editor.reviewer_human_hint: This member reviews the delivery; approval completes the node and rejection starts rework.
editor.reviewer_agent_protocol_hint: The selected agent reviews the Issue context, Worker submission, deliverables, and PR using the built-in Critic standard; approval completes the node and rejection starts rework.
editor.save_rejected: Not saved — this definition does not validate yet.
editor.remove_node_description: “{{node}}” is removed and the connections around it are rejoined. This cannot be undone without discarding your unsaved edits.
editor.case_when_help: Reads upstream output fields, a reviewed node's verdict (review.verdict, review.confidence), and the host issue (issue.priority, issue.status, issue.property.<key>). Cases evaluate top-down; the first match wins.
editor.outputs_hint: Structured facts the executor reports on delivery; gateway conditions route on them.
editor.gateway_mode_switch_help: Branches are checked top-down and the first match wins. Use this when the paths are alternatives.
editor.gateway_mode_filter_help: Every matching branch runs. Use this to add reviews or checks alongside the main line; the fallback runs only when nothing matches.
editor.max_attempts_hint: How many times this activity may run in total before it stops being handed back and waits for a person. Leave empty for no limit.

errors.load: Workflow data could not be loaded.
errors.not_found: This workflow could not be found.
errors.reason_required: A reason and return activity are required.
errors.action_failed: The action failed. Refresh the workflow and try again.
errors.feature_disabled: Workflows are not enabled for this workspace.
